t: This is The King Alfred School, a co-educational independent day school in Golders Green. It was founded in 1898 and was considered radical for its era, because it offered a secular education to boys and girls together. Charles E. Rice, a former teacher at Bedales, started it. Among the other founders were Cecil Sharp, a key figure in the English folk-song revival, and the sculptor Hamo Thornycroft, who made the statue of Oliver Cromwell outside the Palace of Westminster. Alice Mullins, a sculptor, was a founder too, as were a solicitor and a barrister.
